films.title: The Olympic marathon winner who rode in a car — St Louis 1904
films.asset_caveat: Catalogued does NOT mean staged/downloaded, historically matched or independently rights-audited. A listed candidate is not approval for use.

shot_directives.narration: He finished the Olympic marathon first. But he'd ridden in a car.
shot_directives.visible_action: Begin at the 1904 stadium as runner Fred Lorz breaks the finishing tape, then immediately reveal an earlier car silhouette in a quick visual flashback to establish the contradiction.
shot_directives.action_blocking: follow Lorz through the tape; smash-cut to an actual antique motorcar, not a modern saloon
shot_directives.camera_direction: low angle track forwards, hard cut into wheel close-up

shot_directives.narration: In nineteen oh four, Saint Louis was baking under extreme summer heat.
shot_directives.visible_action: Reveal the 1904 marathon starting line as runners set off through wavering heat and thick dust, showing the scale of the competition before focusing on the central fraud.
shot_directives.set: dusty rural race track, hills and trees
shot_directives.action_blocking: 32 starters push off; the camera banks toward heat-hazed road
shot_directives.camera_direction: high descending crane to following track

shot_directives.narration: Only one water stop served thirty-two runners on that dusty course.
shot_directives.visible_action: Track exhausted runners past a dry roadside and show a single distant midcourse well, making the lack of drinking water immediately comprehensible without fake statistics.
shot_directives.set: single roadside well and winding unpaved road
shot_directives.action_blocking: runners pass a distant well, then an empty road; no fabricated station
shot_directives.camera_direction: long lateral tracking shot along road

shot_directives.narration: Fred Lorz dropped out exhausted, then climbed into an automobile.
shot_directives.visible_action: The camera follows Lorz stopping and rubbing aching legs as a period automobile rolls alongside and he clearly climbs inside instead of continuing on foot.
shot_directives.set: carriage road shoulder with motorcar stopped
shot_directives.action_blocking: Lorz visibly slows, bends, opens the automobile door and climbs into its seat
shot_directives.camera_direction: moving medium shot from side to door handle

shot_directives.narration: When the car broke down, he stepped out and began running again.
shot_directives.visible_action: Show the automobile lurching to a stop as the engine fails, then Lorz exits and resumes running on the same marked marathon road ahead of the pack.
shot_directives.action_blocking: car advances, sputters and stops; Lorz gets out and runs away
shot_directives.camera_direction: wheel-height close-up then follow runner

shot_directives.narration: He reached the stadium first, and thousands cheered for their new champion.
shot_directives.visible_action: The same runner enters the stadium as a crowd rises and officials initially present him as winner; position the finish line as a real action rather than relying on captions.
shot_directives.action_blocking: Lorz enters stadium, crosses finish line, crowd and judges celebrate
shot_directives.camera_direction: camera leads Lorz, slight orbit around finish

shot_directives.narration: Then officials uncovered his shortcut. The apparent winner was disqualified.
shot_directives.visible_action: A race official points to the vehicle route on the race map while another withdraws Lorz from the victory position and the crowd changes from cheers to surprise.
shot_directives.action_blocking: official points to a car route on map, removes Lorz from winner's place
shot_directives.camera_direction: map insert and rack-focus to Lorz

shot_directives.narration: Far behind him, Thomas Hicks was staggering toward the finish, nearly collapsing.
shot_directives.visible_action: Cut to exhausted Thomas Hicks struggling to stand on the dusty road as his two attendants support him toward the stadium without hiding his physical distress.
shot_directives.set: dusty hilly stretch on approach to finish
shot_directives.action_blocking: Hicks totters while two attendants keep him moving
shot_directives.camera_direction: handheld-feel low follow with stable horizon

shot_directives.narration: His attendants gave him strychnine, a dangerous stimulant, along with egg whites.
shot_directives.visible_action: The attendants administer a small period medicine preparation and egg whites in close-up while Hicks hesitates, framed as historical evidence not advice for viewers to imitate.
shot_directives.action_blocking: attendant holds historical bottle and prepared egg whites; Hicks takes it
shot_directives.camera_direction: macro on cup and hands then Hicks reaction

shot_directives.narration: Hicks finished with help, and officials declared him the actual winner.
shot_directives.visible_action: Two attendants visibly guide the barely walking Hicks across the same stadium finish line, and an official records his result as the real winner after the correction.
shot_directives.action_blocking: two handlers assist Hicks over line; official writes his result in ledger
shot_directives.camera_direction: frontal medium follow then tight scorebook insert
shot_directives.synchronized_foley: soft crowd build, chalk and paper

shot_directives.narration: The first finisher had driven. The actual winner was barely standing.
shot_directives.visible_action: Compose an authored match cut contrasting Lorz climbing out of a stopped automobile with Hicks nearly falling at the official finish; both distinct events must be understandable.
shot_directives.set: same track reused with match cut
shot_directives.action_blocking: repeat exact prior actions as brief visual comparison: Lorz leaving car / Hicks supported
shot_directives.camera_direction: purposeful matched screen direction, no split-screen captions hiding action

shot_directives.narration: That really happened at the Olympics. Subscribe to Facts Uncovered.
shot_directives.visible_action: Hold a brief authentic race-era stadium overview as an accurate 1904 result title resolves the story, then add a legible Facts Uncovered subscribe message in the final seconds.
shot_directives.set: full stadium track and score result
shot_directives.action_blocking: show THOMAS HICKS / WINNER 1904, transition to Facts Uncovered subscription in final two seconds
shot_directives.camera_direction: high rising three-quarter view with restrained dolly

films.title: The dead man whose briefcase fooled German intelligence — Operation Mincemeat
films.asset_caveat: Catalogued does NOT mean staged/downloaded, historically matched or independently rights-audited. A listed candidate is not approval for use.

shot_directives.narration: In 1943, Britain sent a dead man to fool Germany's generals.
shot_directives.visible_action: Open on the gloved hands of a British intelligence officer fastening a document case to a lifeless, fully clothed man's wrist; the camera pushes in on its seal.
shot_directives.action_blocking: gloved officer secures a period case to a fully-clothed lifeless officer; avoid gore
shot_directives.camera_direction: deliberate overhead push toward clasp

shot_directives.narration: The Allies planned to invade Sicily, where German defenses might be waiting.
shot_directives.visible_action: British planners move an actual Sicily invasion marker onto a three-dimensional Mediterranean table map while defensive markers surround the island and block the route.
shot_directives.action_blocking: hands place British landing counters on Sicily, revealing an obvious risk
shot_directives.camera_direction: overhead track down to Sicily's coast

shot_directives.narration: So intelligence officers invented a Royal Marines major named William Martin.
shot_directives.visible_action: Officers visibly assemble a fabricated naval identity card, adding the name William Martin beside genuine-looking military service paperwork, without inventing authentic archival documents.
shot_directives.action_blocking: invented 'Major William Martin' card is typed and placed beside papers
shot_directives.camera_direction: macro typewriter to identity card

shot_directives.narration: They gave the body a uniform and pockets full of convincing personal details.
shot_directives.visible_action: A gloved officer places carefully selected civilian possessions, letters and the photograph of an invented sweetheart in the uniform's pockets to make the false identity believable.
shot_directives.action_blocking: hands slide wallet, letter, watch and portrait into the uniform pockets
shot_directives.camera_direction: wide-to-macro hand sweep

shot_directives.narration: His briefcase carried supposedly secret plans naming Greece and Sardinia, not Sicily.
shot_directives.visible_action: A hand slides deliberately forged operation letters into the leather briefcase; a Mediterranean map visibly highlights Greece and Sardinia as false destinations while Sicily fades.
shot_directives.set: same map and locked leather case
shot_directives.action_blocking: false destination letters inserted; Greece and Sardinia physically marked, Sicily left unmarked
shot_directives.camera_direction: macro on forged document then over shoulder map

shot_directives.narration: A British submarine released him off Spain, hoping the documents would be found.
shot_directives.visible_action: A period-appropriate submarine surfaces near Huelva; sailors respectfully lower the fully clothed body into the sea as the case remains secured without graphic imagery.
shot_directives.action_blocking: crew gently lowers fully-clothed body into water with case attached
shot_directives.camera_direction: low side angle tracing surface and lowering rope

shot_directives.narration: Spanish authorities recovered him. German intelligence gained access to the briefcase.
shot_directives.visible_action: A Spanish shoreline recovery becomes an official paperwork handover; the scene follows the same sealed briefcase into a guarded intelligence office where it is opened.
shot_directives.action_blocking: recovery workers retrieve case, then an officer hands it to a contact; hands open it indoors
shot_directives.camera_direction: documentary side track then detail insert
shot_directives.synchronized_foley: coastal surf to leather case open

shot_directives.narration: Back in London, British agents pretended to panic about those missing papers.
shot_directives.visible_action: A British intelligence officer urgently drafts and sends a recall telegram while a second officer calmly checks the planned deception on a hidden board behind him.
shot_directives.set: British intelligence office and telegram machine
shot_directives.action_blocking: officer visibly types urgent recovery request, messenger exits; second officer calmly watches
shot_directives.camera_direction: medium shot with tracking departure

shot_directives.narration: When the case returned, officers found evidence the letters were opened.
shot_directives.visible_action: The case reopens on an evidence desk and an investigator detects subtle handling of the internal letters, then compares the opened envelope with earlier placement evidence.
shot_directives.action_blocking: investigator inspects disturbed sealed envelope and compares to earlier position
shot_directives.camera_direction: extreme close-up rotating over tabletop

shot_directives.narration: Germany reinforced Greece and Sardinia, believing the fake plans were real.
shot_directives.visible_action: German troop markers visibly move away from the Sicily area toward Greece and Sardinia on a historically grounded map, emphasizing consequence rather than unrelated generic marching troops.
shot_directives.action_blocking: troop counters reposition toward Greece/Sardinia; Sicily conspicuously thins
shot_directives.camera_direction: oblique close-up following a single counter

shot_directives.narration: But in July, Allied troops landed in Sicily—the real invasion target.
shot_directives.visible_action: Switch from the false map to the real Sicilian coastline as Allied landing craft advance and soldiers disembark at the intended island, delivering the opening promise visually.
shot_directives.action_blocking: amphibious craft approaches Sicily, landing ramp falls, troops visibly disembark
shot_directives.camera_direction: wide-to-medium forward track

shot_directives.narration: One dead man's invented identity helped mislead an army. Subscribe to Facts Uncovered.
shot_directives.visible_action: Match cut from the Sicilian invasion map to the original case and identity card, revealing the cost and ingenuity of the deception; finish on a tasteful subscribe title.
shot_directives.set: same identity card, case, Sicily map
shot_directives.action_blocking: briefcase closes as fabricated identity is revealed; final Facts Uncovered CTA
shot_directives.camera_direction: close pullback to case; final two seconds branded
